issues.detail: The Hebrew 'יסורי בארץ יכתבו' (those who turn away in the land will be written) is rendered as 'những kẻ sa ngã khỏi đất sẽ bị ghi tên' (those who fall away from the land will be recorded). The Hebrew 'יסורי' (from סור, to turn aside/depart) is translated as 'sa ngã' (fall away), and 'בארץ' (in the land) is rendered as 'khỏi đất' (from the land), changing the meaning from 'in the land' to 'from the land'.
